QuestInfo.name: Grand Crystal
QuestInfo.0: Vieren wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: Vieren says that the legendary Grand Crystal may be hidden in the Golden Temple. Go look for it.

0.0:
Anyway, I found an interesting phrase in one of my dusty old books.
#b'The ultimate light is the slumbering gold.'#k
#L0##bWhy did ancient scholars insist on couching everything in riddle?#l
#k
0.1: You're no fun! It's easy. The riddle is obviously about the Grand Crystal of legend. Obviously. This 'slumbering gold' is probably a reference to the Golden Temple. You should check it out.

yes.0: You can only get to Golden Temple through the Maple Guide and Mu Lung Crane (taxi).

no.0: You sure? We really could use a Grand Crystal.

1.0: Vieren spoke true! The Grand Crystal is an awe-inspiring artifact, to be certain.
